note: The diagonal sum is stated for all `‖z‖ ≤ r`, without the restriction 4e‖h‖ < rR that [M] needs for convergence from the norm bound; here the line series gives convergence. The hypothesis is `Often` at p = R/2 rather than the stencil bound.

snippet.text:
lemma labels (k:ℝ) (he:0≤k)(hp:∀ i,‖u i‖≤k): ‖L.anchor n u‖ ≤ (k*fee p r)^n*c:=by
    let F:= ((Nat.factorial n:ℕ):ℝ); let Ω:= (univ:Finset (Fin n)); have hb:= L.width; have h₀:= zero_lt_one.trans_le L.pays.1
    have hz T (ht:T∈Ω.powerset): ‖signed Ω T • L.bank n (0+∑ i∈T,u i)‖≤ ((n*k/r)/p)^n*c:=by
       rw [norm_smul,signed,norm_pow,norm_neg,norm_one,one_pow,one_mul,zero_add]
       apply lend'; apply le_trans (norm_sum_le ..); refine (sum_le_sum (fun i _=>hp i)).trans ?_; rw [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]; rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hb.ne']; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ he; exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (by simpa [Ω] using card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp ht))
    have hc:↑(Ω.powerset.card)=(2:ℝ)^n:=by simp [Ω]
    unfold anchor; rw [norm_smul,norm_inv,Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have hE: (n:ℝ)^n/F ≤ (Real.exp 1)^n:= by
       rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul,mul_one]; exact le_trans (by apply single_le_sum (f:=fun i:ℕ=>(n:ℝ)^i/i.factorial) (fun _ _=>by positivity) (mem_range.mpr n.lt_succ_self)) (Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (by positivity) (n+1))
    calc
      _ ≤ F⁻¹*((2:ℝ)^n*(((n*k/r)/p)^n*c)):= mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((norm_sum_le ..).trans ((sum_le_sum hz).trans_eq (by rw [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hc]))) (by positivity)
      _ = (n^n/F:ℝ) * ((2*k/(r*p))^n*c) := by
         push_cast; simp only [div_pow,mul_pow]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
        change _ ≤ (k*(2*Real.exp 1/(r*p)))^n*c; push_cast
        apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (show 0≤(2*k/(r*p))^n*c from mul_nonneg (by positivity) L.pays.2)).trans_eq
        simp [div_pow,mul_pow]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: `‖anchor n u‖ ≤ (k*fee p r)^n*c` when all `‖u i‖ ≤ k`: 2^n terms of norm at most n k/(rp) c, with n^n/n! ≤ e^n, `fee = 2e/(rp)`.

snippet.text: lemma course: ‖L.gardenL n‖≤ fee p r^n*c:= MultilinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ (mul_nonneg (by unfold fee; have hh:=L.width; have hp:=zero_lt_one.trans_le L.pays.1; positivity) L.pays.2) _

proof_context.conclusion: `‖gardenL n‖ ≤ fee p r ^ n * c`, so with p = R/2 and c = 2C the operator bound is 2C(4e/(rR))^n.

snippet.text: lemma party (z:X)(hz:‖z‖ ≤r) : HasSum (fun n=>L.gardenL n (fun _=>z)) (f (x+z)):= by simp_rw [seeds]; exact L.gift z hz

proof_context.conclusion: `∑_n gardenL n (z,...,z)` has sum `f (x+z)` for every `‖z‖ ≤ r`.

snippet.text:
lemma stage : ∃ (P:FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ I Y), (∀ n, ‖P n‖ ≤ fee p r^n*c) ∧ ∀ z,‖z‖≤r → HasSum (fun n=> P n (fun _=> e z)) (f (x+z)) := by
   choose P hP h using fun n:ℕ=> give (Y:=Y) e he h n; exact ⟨fun n=>P n (L.gardenL n),fun n=> (hP ..).trans (L.course n),fun z hz=> (L.party _ hz).congr_fun (fun n=>h n _ (fun _=>z))⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The multilinear series with `‖P n‖ ≤ fee^n c` also represents `f (x+z)` on a dense isometric embedding `e`, the completion.
